definitions.explanation: Before the expected time; by now.
No longer; not from this point forward.

notes:
もう is a versatile adverb with several related meanings.

MEANINGS:
1. Already: An action/state completed earlier than expected
2. Anymore (with negatives): No longer, not from now on
3. More/another: An additional amount

COMMON PATTERNS:
- もう〜した: already did ~
- もう〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not ~ anymore
- もう⟦{一|いっ}{回|かい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧: one more time
- もう⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧: a little more
- もう⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: one more (thing)

CONTRAST:
- もう vs. ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧: "already" vs. "still/not yet"
- もう⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (already ate) vs. ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{食|た}べていない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (haven't eaten yet)

HOW TO TELL THE SENSES APART:
The surrounding grammar decides which meaning もう has. With a past or completed form it means "already"; with a negative it means "anymore"; directly before a number or quantity word it means "more."

WORD ORDER (sense 3): もう comes immediately before the amount, never after it — もう⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧, もう⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧, もう⟦{一|いっ}{回|かい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧. The reverse order is ungrammatical.

SPOKEN USE:
On its own, drawn out as もう〜, it works as an exclamation of exasperation, roughly "oh, come on" or "geez." This is casual speech only.
